---
title: "Realism (Output 4)"
guide-section: "User Guide"
---

Excel analogues: the Realism tools, Imported data, and Output 4-1 / 4-2.
Edit those inputs in Excel, save, then compute the Output 4 panels.

> Excel → realism inputs + baseline books → Output 4 panels

## Compute all Output 4 panels

```python
from pathlib import Path

from lic_dsf.run import (
    SHEET_4_1,
    SHEET_4_2_FISCAL_ADJ,
    SHEET_4_2_INVEST,
    SHEET_4_2_MULTIPLIER,
    compute_outputs,
)

workbook = Path("data/lic-dsf-template-2025-08-12.xlsx")
names = [
    SHEET_4_1,
    SHEET_4_2_FISCAL_ADJ,
    SHEET_4_2_MULTIPLIER,
    SHEET_4_2_INVEST,
]
output = compute_outputs(workbook, include=names)

forecast_error = output.sheets[SHEET_4_1]
fiscal_adjustment = output.sheets[SHEET_4_2_FISCAL_ADJ]
fiscal_multiplier = output.sheets[SHEET_4_2_MULTIPLIER]
invest_growth = output.sheets[SHEET_4_2_INVEST]
```

| Panel | What it shows |
|-------|---------------|
| Forecast error | Current debt path against a prior imported-data vintage |
| Fiscal adjustment | Three-year adjustment and placement among LIC programs |
| Fiscal multiplier | Growth implications across multiplier assumptions |
| Invest-growth | Capital stock and public-investment growth contribution |

For individual calculations, call `load_core` and `load_realism`, then use
`forecast_error_panel`, `fiscal_adjustment_panel`,
`fiscal_multiplier_panel`, or `invest_growth_panel`. The paired notebook
shows that expanded workflow.

## Excel cues

| Concept | Template |
|---------|----------|
| Debt forecast errors | Output 4-1 |
| Fiscal adjustment distribution | Realism / Output 4-2 |
| Investment and capital assumptions | Realism capital block |
| Multiplier assumptions | Realism multiplier grid |

Forecast-error output depends on compatible imported-data vintages. If the
required prior debt or GDP series is absent, the panel reports that missing
input rather than inventing a comparison.

The complete worked example is
[`demo/realism.ipynb`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/realism.ipynb).
